Name: Thestral Mount
Author: NightshadowCat93
Description:
Thestral skin tested on Adopt and Skin mod

To use it just download the zipped file, unzip it, take the png file you want to use, go to the "assets" folder of the Adopt and Skin mod, then go to "skins" and create a folder there named "Horse" and just drop or copy/paste your thestral skin there and rename it "Horse_1" to replace your horse's skin with this one.

Should work with other mods but not tested yet/might need some coding.
Will be included in a Hogwarts mod (a wip by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/index.php?/user/85287593-sexynes/]sexynes[/url])/maybe available for AT/CP in the future

Enjoy your thestral and let me know if you like it!
